limitations: Every cited page was fetched fresh over HTTPS with curl using a browser user agent on 2026-09-09; none of the 25 pages cited by documented claims required a second retry, and none returned JavaScript placeholder tokens for the specific worked examples the draft quoted.

Two sources listed in the research file, src-cdse-quotas and src-rasterframes, are not cited by any documented claim's source_ids (they appear only in candidate_notes observations) and were not fetched for this check, which covers documented claims only.

HTML-to-text extraction for this check replaces tags with spaces, which occasionally inserts a stray space around inline <code> or <em> elements at a hyphen or before a comma/period. Three quotes (cl-cp-batch-containers-orchestrator_dependency-2, cl-cp-kubernetes-dask-idempotency, cl-cp-spark-cluster-scaling_water_bodies-2) needed punctuation-aware whitespace normalization to match for this reason; each was manually inspected in context on the source page and confirmed as a rendering artifact, not a wording difference.

Verification covered each claim's quote, value, unit, and the specific factual assertions in its note. It did not re-verify every sentence in candidate_notes, not_assessed, or the draft's own limitations section, since those are not claim records under the check schema.

No cloud API was called, no package was installed, and no page requiring an authenticated session or a JavaScript-executing browser was used, consistent with the documentation-and-pricing-pages-only bound on this check.
